title: Satellite-based oil spill detection using an explainable ViR-SC hybrid deep learning ensemble for improved accuracy and transparency.
summary: ViR-SC combines a denoising autoencoder, U-Net++ localization and CNN/ResNet18/ViT/SVM/RF classifiers on 5,630 CSIRO Sentinel-1 patches with an 80/20 split; ensemble reports 98.45% accuracy and 98.37% F1.
